name: Inventory Rules for WooCommerce
author: corvowp

sections.description:
Inventory Rules for WooCommerce gives store owners simple, reliable quantity rules for products and variations.

The free plugin includes:
* Minimum quantities
* Maximum quantities
* Quantity increments
* Global defaults
* Product and variation-level rules
* Cart validation
* WooCommerce Store API quantity limits

Need advanced category rules, reusable presets, bulk editing, customer-role rules, schedules, conditions, analytics and more? A separate Premium add-on is available from CorvoWP.

Privacy

The free plugin does not require an account or license key and does not send inventory data to a remote licensing service.

External Services

The free plugin does not contact any external service for its functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate Inventory Rules for WooCommerce.
  3. Configure global defaults under Inventory Rules > Settings.
  4. Configure individual product rules from the Inventory Rules panel in the WooCommerce product editor.
sections.changelog:
1.3.4

  • Removed in-dashboard, settings-screen, product-editor and plugin-row upgrade promotions to keep the admin experience focused on the free plugin.
  • Retained the complete free Inventory Rules functionality and existing WordPress.org compatibility fixes.

1.3.3

  • Fixed Plugin Check internationalization findings with translator context and ordered placeholders.
  • Documented WooCommerce’s upstream nonce verification for product and variation save hooks.
  • Documented the read-only nature of dashboard filter query parameters.
  • Batched the legacy product metadata migration to avoid an unbounded query.

1.3.2

  • Refined dashboard filter control alignment and styling.

1.3.0

  • Split the free core from the optional Premium add-on.
  • Removed license activation and premium code from the WordPress.org plugin.
  • Improved product and variation quantity-rule handling.
